title: How To Discover Your Purpose
text: [Music] all right how do you know what your destiny is write this down i'ma tell you right now number one go out and buy my book called authority number two go and buy my book called the power of vision look at the last chapter number three golden by my book discovering purpose and look at chapter four five six and seven number five go and buy my book uh understanding your potential all these books together to find your destiny but for the sake of those who don't like to read i will give you three of the principles number one your purpose and your destiny is whatever makes you angry that's your purpose and your destiny your anger is your purpose and your destiny what do you mean dr monroe well whatever makes you angry you're supposed to fix everyone was born to solve a problem every time you see the problem you become angry no one else becomes angry just you that's a sign that that's your area of destiny so go find your anger every great woman and man was angry all of them hallelujah number two how do you find your destiny what would you do for no paycheck let me say another way what would you do without compensation what would you do if you never get paid to do it that's your destiny because destiny doesn't work for money that's why a person who found a destiny don't have a job because destiny is not a job it's an assignment bill gates uh was talking to someone they asked him what is the key to your success he said i found something i love to do more than money i love to invent things it's my passion and what i invent solves problems number three finally what is your destiny your destiny is your passion every human has passion but our culture hides it our culture says pursue a career for paychecks not for passion and so you live just to survive not to make a difference you
